custom_css: /* Sleek thin border for Add to Cart + View Cart */button[name="add"],.cart-notification .button,.cart-drawer .button,.cart-drawer .button--primary {background: #fff !important; border: 1.5px solid #111 !important; border-radius: 9999px !important; box-shadow: none !important; transform: translateZ(0);}
/* Prevent mobile clipping of bottom edge */.product-form .product-form__buttons,.cart-notification,.cart-drawer,.cart-drawer__footer,.cart-drawer form {overflow: visible !important;}

settings.custom_liquid:
<script>
(()=> {
  // Draw a thin "border" using an inset box-shadow (keeps pill shape, no bg change)
  const RING = 'box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px #111; border-radius:9999px; transform:translateZ(0)';

  const isViewCart = (el) => {
    const txt = (el.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const href = (el.getAttribute('href') || '').toLowerCase();
    // match "View cart" or any link that clearly goes to /cart
    return /view\s*cart/.test(txt) || (/\/cart/.test(href) && !/checkout/.test(href));
  };

  const isCheckout = (el) => {
    const txt = (el.textContent || '').toLowerCase();
    const href = (el.getAttribute('href') || '').toLowerCase();
    return /checkout/.test(txt) || /checkout/.test(href) || el.name === 'checkout';
  };

  const paint = (el) => {
    if (!el || isCheckout(el) || !isViewCart(el)) return;   // skip checkout; only style "View cart"
    el.style.cssText += ';' + RING;
  };

  function sweep(){
    document.querySelectorAll(
      '.cart-notification .button, .cart-notification__links a, .cart-notification__cta .button, '+
      '.cart-drawer .button, .cart-drawer a, .cart-drawer [type="button"]'
    ).forEach(paint);
  }

  // Run now and on DOM changes when popup/drawer opens
  new MutationObserver(sweep).observe(document.body, { childList:true, subtree:true });
  sweep();
})();
</script>
